faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Sprinter 210-216 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. Across T1N production from 1995 to 2006, it used several different engines: OM601, OM602, OM611, OM612 and OM647 - with capacities ranging from 2.2 to 2.9 litres. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Sprinter 210-216 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for all engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Sprinter 210-216 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM601, OM602, OM611, OM612 or OM647 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM601 Sprinter engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain/gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM601 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM602 Sprinter engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain/gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM602 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM611 Sprinter engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain/gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM611 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild OM612 Sprinter engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We replace timing chain/gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM612 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Sprinter 210-216 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Sprinter 210-216 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Sprinter 210-216 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Sprinter owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
